title: persatuan nyang meujak kehancuran
intro: Bayangkan droe neuh teulindong dimiyueb bubong nyang saban ngon wahyu, teuma neupileh kesetiaan nyang beda. Tokoh nyoe udep that toe ngon kebenaran dan kenabian, teuma meugisa ubak ureueng-ureueng nyang jitulak nyan. Kisah awaknyan teudong sibagoe peuingat nyang suci bahwa keutoe ngon keubeunaran mantong hana hase jipeuseulamat jiwa nyang jikhianat keu amanah.
clues: Lon tinggai lam rumoh tangga sidroe nabi nyang geupiléh lé Allah.
Lon teupeue keubeunaran nyang geupeusampoe le lakoe lon, teuma lon hana beutoi-beutoi peucaya.
Lon khianat keupercayaan gobnyan deungon lon meupihak keu ureung-ureung gobnyan nyang ditulak dan lon bantu awaknyan jilawan gobnyan.
Lon disebutkan di samping pasangan nabi laen yang juga mengkhianati, sebagai contoh bagi ureung kafir.
Kisah lon peugah lam Surah At-Tahrim seubagoe peuingat bahwa kekerabatan keu nabi hana geubri perlindungan.
Ulôn binasa sajan ureuëng-ureuëng zalim watèë Allah peubinasa kawôm Nabi Lut, tinggai sajan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang mantong na.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meukhianat nabi deungon cara geubantu ureung kafir geulawan gobnyan .
Tiek sidroe aneuëk manyak lam krueng lam keranjang keu tapeuseulamat jihnyan .
Geutuntut saboh aneuk leumo meuh beu geupeugot bak masa nabi hana
Ditudoh sidroe menteri nyang ade salah dan dipeutamong lam glab .
Geupimpin teuntra gajah keu geujak peubinasa Ka'bah .
trial.answer: Meukhianat nabi deungon cara geubantu ureung kafir geulawan gobnyan .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Banda-banda nyang ka teubalék nibak kawöm Lut .
Bahtera nyan geupeugot dimiyub peurintah ilahi .
Apui nyan jipeugot seujuk keu Ibrahim .
Gua teumpat meulindong aneuk muda nyang teungoh teungeut .
Krueng teumpat meurumpok keranjang aneuk miet nyan .
location.answer: Banda-banda nyang ka teubalék nibak kawöm Lut .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Binasa sajan kaphé walau meunikah ngön nabi .
Ka geupeuseulamat meusajan ngon ureueng meuiman dan geutamong lam syuruga deungon sijahtra .
Ka geu ubah jeut keu tiang seubagoe tanda keu generasi ukeu .
Ka jiteugom lé bumoe deungon hareuta nyang hana meubataih .
Dibri aneuk ajaib bak masa tuha .
outcome.answer: Binasa sajan kaphé walau meunikah ngön nabi .

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
